library(readxl)
# Use the notebook path
input_path <- "inputs/set-membership-111111111111.xlsx"
# List sheets
sheets <- excel_sheets(input_path)
cat("Sheets:", paste(sheets, collapse=", "), "\n")
# Read each sheet to inspect
for (s in sheets) {
  cat("\n=== Sheet:", s, "===\n")
  d <- read_excel(input_path, sheet = s)

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
input_path <- "inputs/set-membership-111111111111.xlsx"
d <- read_excel(input_path, sheet = "5 groups")
# Replace NA/empty with unique placeholders
for (col in colnames(d)) {
  d[[col]][is.na(d[[col]]) | d[[col]] == ""] <- paste0("__NA_", col, "__", seq_along(d[[col]][is.na(d[[col]]) | d[[col]] == ""]))
}
sets <- list(
  A = unique(d$A),
  B = unique(d$B),
  C = unique(d$C),
  D = unique(d$D),
  E = unique(d$E)
)
cat("Sizes:\n")
for (nm in names(sets)) cat(nm, "=", length(sets[[nm]]), "\n")
# Compute cross table of intersections
all_elems <- unique(unlist(sets))
membership <- sapply(sets, function(s) all_elems %in% s)
counts <- rowSums(membership)
cat("\nElement count distribution (in how many sets):\n")
print(table(counts))
# Count intersections of all combinations of >= 2 sets
# Use combn
library(eulerr)
fit <- euler(membership)
cat("\nEuler fit:\n")
print(fit)

library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(VennDiagram)
input_path <- "inputs/set-membership-111111111111.xlsx"
d <- read_excel(input_path, sheet = "5 groups")
# Replace NA with unique placeholders so each NA only counts once
for (col in colnames(d)) {
  na_idx <- which(is.na(d[[col]]) | d[[col]] == "")
  d[[col]][na_idx] <- paste0("__NA_", col, "__", seq_along(na_idx))
}
sets <- list(
  A = unique(d$A),
  B = unique(d$B),
  C = unique(d$C),
  D = unique(d$D),
  E = unique(d$E)
)
cat("Set sizes:\n")
print(sapply(sets, length))
# Use VennDiagram venn() which auto-computes intersections for >=2 sets
venn_obj <- venn(sets, show.plot = FALSE)
cat("\nIntersections (region count by combination):\n")
print(venn_obj)

library(VennDiagram)
library(dplyr)
# Use the data we already loaded
sets <- list(
  A = unique(d$A),
  B = unique(d$B),
  C = unique(d$C),
  D = unique(d$D),
  E = unique(d$E)
)
# Get all intersection regions
parts <- get.venn.partitions(sets)
cat("Number of regions:", nrow(parts), "\n\n")
print(parts)
# Sum should equal sum of all unique elements in any set
cat("\nTotal count (sum of region counts):", sum(parts$count), "\n")
cat("Unique elements across all sets:", length(unique(unlist(sets))), "\n")

# Extract just the boolean pattern and count
parts_simple <- data.frame(
  pattern = apply(parts[, c("A","B","C","D","E")], 1, paste0, collapse=""),
  count = parts$count
)
parts_simple <- parts_simple[order(-parts_simple$count), ]
cat("Region counts sorted:\n")
print(parts_simple, row.names = FALSE)
cat("\nSum of counts:", sum(parts_simple$count), "\n")
cat("Total unique elements:", length(unique(unlist(sets))), "\n")

pattern <- paste(parts$A, parts$B, parts$C, parts$D, parts$E, sep="")
parts_simple <- data.frame(pattern = pattern, count = parts$count, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
parts_simple <- parts_simple[order(-parts_simple$count), ]
cat("Region counts sorted:\n")
print(parts_simple, row.names = FALSE)
cat("\nSum of counts:", sum(parts_simple$count), "\n")
cat("Total unique elements across all sets:", length(unique(unlist(sets))), "\n")

cat("Column names of parts:\n")
print(colnames(parts))
cat("\nClass of parts:\n")
print(class(parts))
cat("\nDimensions:\n")
print(dim(parts))
cat("\nFirst row sample:\n")
print(parts[1, ])

pattern <- paste(parts$A, parts$B, parts$C, parts$D, parts$E, sep="")
parts_simple <- data.frame(pattern = pattern, count = parts$`..count..`, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
parts_simple <- parts_simple[order(-parts_simple$count), ]
cat("Region counts (sorted):\n")
print(parts_simple, row.names = FALSE)
cat("\nSum of counts:", sum(parts_simple$count), "\n")
cat("Total unique elements across all sets:", length(unique(unlist(sets))), "\n")

library(VennDiagram)
# Use venn.diagram - this auto-scales ellipse areas for 5 sets based on set sizes
out_path <- "venn_5sets_proportional.png"
vd <- venn.diagram(
  x = sets,
  category.names = c("A", "B", "C", "D", "E"),
  filename = out_path,
  output = TRUE,
  imagetype = "png",
  resolution = 200,
  compression = "lzw",
  lwd = 1,
  col = "transparent",
  fill = c("#E64B35B2", "#4DBBD5B2", "#00A087B2", "#3C5488B2", "#F39B7FB2"),
  alpha = 0.6,
  cat.col = c("#E64B35", "#4DBBD5", "#00A087", "#3C5488", "#F39B7F"),
  cat.cex = 1.4,
  cat.fontface = "bold",
  cat.pos = c(0, 180, 0, 180, 0),
  cat.dist = c(0.05, 0.05, 0.05, 0.05, 0.05),
  cex = 1.0,
  fontface = "bold",
  main = "Synthetic Venn diagram (5  groups)",
  main.cex = 1.6,
  margin = 0.08,
  scaled = TRUE  # makes ellipse areas proportional to set sizes
)
cat("Saved:", out_path, "\n")
cat("File exists:", file.exists(out_path), "\n")
cat("File size:", file.info(out_path)$size, "bytes\n")
